fields.notes: RS-485 is an electrical-only standard; verification is split into (a) chip-level transceiver electrical conformance per the TIA/EIA-485-A specification points and (b) system-level cable / termination / isolation / noise tests per the engineering practices summarized in SLLA272D. Higher-level link-layer compliance (Modbus RTU CRC, DL/T645 BCC) is verified separately by industry test suites (e.g. Modbus Conformance Test Tool).
verification_categories_derived_from_spe: Register access (read/write to all register fields; reserved-bit behavior)
Nominal transfer / transaction across the protocol's operating modes
Error and fault condition detection and handling
